name: notice-board-visit-host-draw-v1
description: ⭐ S17, THE HOST DRAW: WHEN A NEIGHBOUR VISITS YOU, YOU DRAW 1 CARD. Dean ruled it on 11/09/2026 and ⭐ ITS PROVENANCE IS A TABLE RATHER THAN A SIMULATION, which is rare enough in this project to be the first thing recorded about it. Dean PLAYED overlays/notice-board-visit-two-boards-v1.overlay.json at a two-player table on 11/09/2026 and house-ruled this in during the session. His verdict on that session: the visiting worked well, everyone visited, every Notice Board was used at some stage, and "the rule that the person who gets visited draws a card led to a lot of extra cards in play, which relieved the tightness of the game in a useful way". He has now ruled it in. THE RULE IN ONE LINE: everything in the two-board arm, plus the owner of a visited Notice Board immediately draws one card off a deck. ⛔ ITS CONTROL AND ITS PAIRED ARM IS overlays/notice-board-visit-two-boards-v1.overlay.json, AND THE TWO DIFFER IN EXACTLY ONE LEAF: rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisit, 0 against 1. Everything else in this file is that arm pinned leaf for leaf, so every delta between the two columns is this rule and nothing else. Run them paired on identical reference-v15 seeds. ⛔ IT AMENDS S7 OF docs/notice-board-visit-handoff-2026-09-10-v2.md, WHICH SAID THE OPPOSITE IN AS MANY WORDS. S7 [ruled] reads that the card stays on the board it was played to, its owner harvests it into their barn like any other building, "and that is the payment and there is no other". Under S17 there is now one other and it is paid INSTANTLY: the host is paid twice, once in a card drawn now and once in material they must still harvest and then deliver. THE AMENDMENT IS RECORDED HERE SO THAT NOBODY LATER FINDS TWO RULES THAT CONTRADICT EACH OTHER WITH NO NOTE. Do not quote S7 forward without S17 beside it. ⭐ WHY IT IS DEFENSIBLE, AND BOTH HALVES ARE ON THE RECORD. (1) IT IS THE SANCTIONED SHAPE RATHER THAN A BANNED ONE. This project banned RESTOCK as "a per-interaction bank faucet", and the standing rule alongside that ban reads: "if a give-cards effect returns, it pays in draws". A host draw comes off a DECK and never off a bank, so it is the shape the ban left open rather than the shape the ban closed. (2) THE DESIGN LENS PREDICTS IT. The fault named in all seven previous versions of this bonus slot is PAY THE GIVER IN THE SAME ACT, OR THE GIVER DRAWS THE CHARGE. S7 pays the host in DEFERRED material they must harvest and then deliver; S17 pays them in the same act. It is a closer fit to the lens than the rule it amends. ⚠️ AND THE COST IS REAL, RECORDED RATHER THAN ARGUED AWAY: EVERY VISIT NOW ADDS A CARD TO THE GAME. At two seats under the control arm there are about 14.4 visits received per player per game, so this is a substantial new faucet and it is the reason the barn glut and the game length have to be read beside the rate rather than after it. ⛔ THE MEASUREMENT CAVEAT, AND IT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT SENTENCE IN THIS FILE: THE SIMULATOR CANNOT MEASURE THE EFFECT DEAN ACTUALLY LIKED. The engine caps hands at 7 as an INSTRUMENT BOUND (C7) while the table plays with NO HAND LIMIT AT ALL, and this rule's principal effect is MORE CARDS IN HAND, so the instrument clips exactly the thing the table enjoyed. A run of this arm can honestly answer: does the bonus rate leave Dean's 30% to 60% band, what happens to the barn glut, to game length, to deliveries per player and to the hook. IT CANNOT ANSWER WHETHER THE GAME FEELS LESS TIGHT. ⛔ NO REPORT OF THIS ARM MAY BE QUOTED AS EVIDENCE ABOUT TIGHTNESS, in either direction. ⭐ WHAT TO READ, IN ORDER. (1) THE BONUS RATE ON THE TURN MEASURE AGAINST DEAN'S 30% TO 60% BAND, BY SEAT COUNT, with the plays measure beside it and never in place of it: judging the band on plays has already cost this project one re-run (09/09/2026). ⚠️ THE CONTROL PASSES AT 51.7% POOLED (2p 44.0 / 3p 49.2 / 4p 59.9), AND A CARD HANDED BACK ON EVERY VISIT MAKES THE NEXT VISIT EASIER TO AFFORD, SO THE RATE IS EXPECTED TO RISE AND THE CEILING IS CLOSE - four seats is already at 59.9, one tenth of a point inside it. If any seat count leaves the band, that is the finding and the rate is the headline. (2) THE BARN GLUT, which FAILS on every arm in this family at +0.5 and is the one reading Dean's table saw clear itself: more cards in hand is more cards reaching the barn, and whether that fixes the glut or feeds it is exactly what the pair answers. (3) GAME LENGTH, DELIVERIES PER PLAYER AND THE HOOK, which is the design's own thesis - the hook read 0.54 in the no-self, no-centre corner and it is the only corner that has ever passed it, so if paying the host MOVES THE HOOK DOWN the rule has cost the thing it was meant to strengthen. (4) ⛔ CARDS IN HAND, QUOTED ONLY AS AN INSTRUMENT READING AND NEVER AS A GAME ONE, because the bound is 7 and the table has none. A hand number from this arm describes the simulator. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME AND HERE IS THE LIST, because the 05/09/2026 lesson is that ruling an arm in rules in its whole bundle. NINETEEN LEAVES: THE EIGHTEEN OF THE TWO-BOARD ARM, UNCHANGED, PLUS THIS RULE. THE NEW LEAF, one: (1) rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisit 1 - S17, and the only difference from the control. THE DESIGN ITSELF, four: (2) rules.turn.visitCurrency 'noticeBoardPower' - the fourth value and never a repointing of 'card', which is the v31 control and carries three passengers this design does not want; (3) rules.turn.bonusTiming 'start' - S5, the bonus FIRST because a turn visibly ends on the main action; (4) rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold 3 - S8, and it is a MINIMUM; (5) rules.economy.noticeBoardBlocks false - S8's plus sign, so cards may always be added and no owner can shut a board by declining to harvest. THE BAN THE ARM IS BUILT ON, one: (6) rules.turn.selfVisitAllowed false - the only corner of the 11/09/2026 2x2 that passes the hook, and ⛔ IT IS ALSO WHAT KEEPS S17 HONEST: a self-visit must never pay the host draw, because drawing a card for visiting yourself is a pure faucet paid by nobody. THE TWO-BOARD MAP, three: (7) rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats.2 = 2, (8) .3 = 1 and (9) .4 = 1, exactly as the control sets them, the last two at their BASE values so the map cannot change shape underneath the arm. THE CENTRE, TURNED OFF BY NAME, one: (10) rules.economy.unclaimedBoardsToCentre FALSE - this family is the ALTERNATIVE to the unclaimed-boards centre and never an addition to it. THE COMMONS FEE RULES AND THE COINS, TURNED OFF BY NAME, five: (11) rules.turn.commonsTake 'harvest', (12) rules.economy.commonsColourMatch false, (13) rules.economy.commonsWildPair false, (14) rules.economy.endgameCoinCost null, (15) rules.economy.farmsteadCoinPower false. THE MEEPLES, STILL NOWHERE, four: (16) rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour 0, (17) rules.turn.meepleAsCard false, (18) rules.turn.slotToll null and (19) rules.turn.meepleCapPerColour null. ⚠️ WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT PINNED, AND WHY, because an unexplained absence reads as an oversight. Everything the control leaves unpinned is left unpinned here for the control's own reasons: rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.* are the base S12 power numbers every arm in this family reads unchanged; rules.economy.commonsThreshold, commonsHarvestMin and commonsHarvestTake have no subject with no centre on the table; rules.turn.meepleAsCardGoesTo, paymentSlotToll and paymentHostChoice are pinned by proxy behind meepleAsCard false; and workers.roster.* is the DOOR roster, which describes nothing when a board grants a POWER. ⛔ AND THIS ARM ADDS TWO ABSENCES OF ITS OWN THAT NOBODY HAD NAMED, BOTH OF THEM DRAW-SIZED NUMBERS AN ENGINE COULD READ BY ACCIDENT INSTEAD OF THE NEW KNOB. rules.turn.bonusDraw is 1 and is the v31 standalone free Draw 1 in the bonus slot, deleted on 04/09/2026 and subjectless under 'noticeBoardPower'; it is NOT the host draw and must never be read as it. rules.turn.baseDraw.see and .keep are 2 and 2, so an engine that implements the host draw by reusing the plain Draw path would hand the host TWO cards rather than the one this knob asks for. Neither is pinned, because pinning either would break the leaf-for-leaf diff against the control that makes this pair readable; both are named here instead. ⚠️ AND THE ENGINE'S HAND LIMIT OF 7 IS THE SIMULATOR'S BOUND AND NOT A RULE OF THE GAME (C7), which under THIS arm is load-bearing on the reading rather than merely true: it is the bound on the very quantity the rule creates. Every report header must say so. ⚠️ TWO ENGINE RULINGS ARE OWED AND NEITHER IS A LEAF, so neither can be pinned here. (1) WHICH DECK DOES THE HOST DRAW FROM - their own suit's, or the top of any deck in play as a plain Draw allows? At two seats island.decksInPlayBySeats is 3, so the answer changes what a host can accumulate. (2) WHAT HAPPENS WHEN A HELPING HAND SENDS A SECOND VISIT TO THE SAME OWNER IN ONE TURN, which is reachable for the first time under the two-board arm because at two seats the one rival holds two boards: two draws to one host in one turn, or one. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against overlays/notice-board-visit-two-boards-v1.overlay.json on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. Stay on reference-v15 and cut reference-v16 only when Dean rules the variant in. UNBUILT IN THE ENGINE AND UNRUN BEFORE THIS PASS: this file is the data layer only. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game.
